Description
Since 1950 we've been on a mission to reimagine higher education. Reshaping it around the dynamic needs of our students.
We believe education is not just about classrooms and text books; it's about nurturing passions, fostering innovation and embracing the spirit of relentless curiosity. 
At Mercy University, we have been helping to empower generations of learners to break new ground, achieve forward momentum and create lasting impact that ripples beyond themselves, to their families and communities.
